start: Owner signed in online on a computer, on Today; the panel read the gym's records a short while ago

user_sees: 'Updated 20 s ago' (or 'Updated just now', 'Updated 3 min ago', 'Updated over an hour ago')
A 'Refresh' button beside it
must_not: Two refresh buttons on one screen
An age that never moves on

user_sees: The button reads 'Refreshing…' and cannot be pressed again

An open form losing what was typed

s1 see: the age words in steps (just now, 20 s, 3 min, over an hour) (data only); an older answer never moves the time back

start: Owner signed in online on a phone

user_sees: A round button with the refresh mark and a short age under it: 'now', '20 s', '3 min' or '1 h+'

must_not: A second read started by a second tap

user_sees: The line goes away and the age reads 'now'
must_not: The line left on screen over the page

user_sees: 'Refreshing…', then 'Could not refresh. Check the internet and try again.' in red (on a phone: '!' under the mark and the same sentence in a line under the top bar)

The age reset to now although nothing new was read

user_sees: No Refresh button and no 'Updated' words at all
must_not: A Refresh button that can only fail

tests.checks: s1 see: with the internet off Refresh ends in 'Could not refresh. Check the internet and try again.'; s1 not: so it does not read 'Updated just now'. 'Refreshing…', the phone '!' and the demo/offline gym having no Refresh are not checked

s1 see: with the internet off Refresh ends in 'Could not refresh. Check the internet and try again.'; s1 not: so it does not read 'Updated just now'. 'Refreshing…', the phone '!' and the demo/offline gym having no Refresh are not checked

steps.action: Turn the internet on and press 'Refresh' again

user_sees: The age counts on by itself: 'Updated 2 min ago'

user_sees: An age that matches the real last read
must_not: 'Updated just now' for data that is ten minutes old
